Initial public release of the SimplePractice skill.

- Read-only access to SimplePractice Client Portals via the simplepractice-mcp server.
- Retrieve upcoming appointments, invoices/statements/superbills, balance, saved cards, forms to sign, and practice announcements.
- Session management: secure, passwordless sign-in flow using emailed one-time links or PINs.
- Supports multiple client profiles (e.g., parent managing for children).
- Emphasizes privacy and accurate representation of available portal data.
